cards.headline: Democrats win control of both the House and the Senate
cards.summary: Democrats won the 218th House seat early Wednesday, and the Associated Press projected a Senate majority after flips in several Republican-held states. Republicans held both chambers and the presidency going into the midterms. Trump says he accepts the results.
cards.why_it_matters: Divided government will shape spending, oversight of the administration and the legislative agenda for Trump's final two years.

cards.headline: Talarico beats Paxton to flip Texas Senate seat
cards.summary: Democrat James Talarico defeated Republican Ken Paxton, the first Democratic Senate win in Texas since 1988. Trump had backed Paxton. Talarico told supporters, 'Tonight we defeated Goliath.' Republicans had held statewide office in Texas for decades.
cards.why_it_matters: Texas is the largest Republican stronghold to flip a Senate seat in years, and it helped decide control of the chamber.

cards.summary: Trump said he is willing to accept the midterm results but argued Republicans would have won in a landslide had he been on the ballot. The Financial Times reports he also acknowledged the Iran war was a factor in the losses.
cards.why_it_matters: The president's reaction signals how the White House will frame the defeat and approach a Democratic Congress.

cards.headline: Troy Jackson ousts Susan Collins in Maine Senate race
cards.summary: Democrat Troy Jackson defeated Republican Sen. Susan Collins, who conceded by phone Tuesday night. Collins had held the seat for nearly 30 years. The BBC notes the race was affected by the earlier withdrawal of another Democratic nominee.
cards.why_it_matters: Losing a longtime moderate Republican removes a swing vote and was one of several pickups that gave Democrats the Senate.

cards.summary: Adam Hamilton beat Sen. Roger Marshall in Kansas, Josh Turek beat Rep. Ashley Hinson in Iowa, Annie Andrews beat Darline Graham in South Carolina, and Roy Cooper beat Michael Whatley in North Carolina. Sherrod Brown also won in Ohio.
cards.why_it_matters: The wins in Republican-leaning states gave Democrats a Senate majority and a check on Trump's nominees and agenda.

cards.headline: Democrats win governorships in Georgia, Ohio, Michigan, Wisconsin
cards.summary: Keisha Lance Bottoms won in Georgia, Amy Acton beat Vivek Ramaswamy in Ohio, Jocelyn Benson won Michigan, David Crowley won Wisconsin and Xavier Becerra won California. Republicans held Florida with Byron Donalds and Alabama with Tommy Tuberville.
cards.why_it_matters: Governors oversee elections, budgets and enforcement of federal policy in their states, so the results shape the next two years and the 2028 map.

cards.summary: Missouri voters defeated Proposition A, which would have allowed a more Republican-friendly congressional map, and a measure that would have reimposed an abortion ban coupled with a ban on transgender treatment for minors. Opponents said the abortion measure was misleading.
cards.why_it_matters: The results show limits to mid-decade redistricting and abortion restrictions at the ballot box, with consequences for House control and reproductive rights.

cards.headline: Stocks and dollar fall as Democratic wins stoke AI worries
cards.summary: Asian and European stock futures fell as traders bet a Democratic Congress could bring tighter scrutiny of AI and slow data center buildout. The dollar had its worst day in a month, while Treasuries and the Swiss franc and yen rose.
cards.why_it_matters: Retirement accounts are heavily weighted toward tech and AI shares, and Treasury yields feed through to mortgage and borrowing costs.

cards.summary: Axios reports members are questioning whether Speaker Mike Johnson or other top deputies can survive next week's leadership elections. Johnson told supporters the party faced 'real odds' and the fight was not over. Reports describe disagreement over who to blame.
cards.why_it_matters: Republican leadership turmoil affects who leads the party in the House and how it opposes a Democratic majority.

cards.summary: Fox News reports Democrats on Capitol Hill told the administration to 'lawyer up' and are preparing subpoenas, naming Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. Hakeem Jeffries said voters sent a message to end extremism and corruption; Republicans have not accepted that framing.
cards.why_it_matters: Congressional oversight can force testimony and documents from the administration and shape the political fight ahead of 2028.

cards.summary: Claire Valdez, backed by Mayor Zohran Mamdani, and Darializa Avila Chevalier won New York House races, and Brad Lander also won. Mamdani said the results show the power of working-class voters. Fox News reports the wins deepen a rift among New York Democrats.

cards.summary: A major election day survey suggests voters named the economy and the state of democracy as top issues, and were most unhappy with the economy. NPR published breakdowns of how demographic groups voted, from a poll by SSRS.

cards.headline: Democratic governors win on pledges to curb data center building
cards.summary: The Financial Times reports Democratic governors elected in Texas, Georgia and Ohio, along with local ballot measures, ran on stopping or limiting data center construction, showing discontent with Trump-backed infrastructure spending.

sources.title: Democratic governors elected on promises to stop data centre building

cards.summary: The Financial Times says Elon Musk put $47 million behind Ken Paxton, who lost in Texas. Tesla and SpaceX shares fell in after-hours trading as Democratic gains emerged. Musk joked about space lasers early Wednesday, Axios reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Musk's political spending and exposure to Washington policy now carry risk for two major companies.

cards.why_it_matters: Talks over reopening the Strait of Hormuz influence US fuel prices and the risk of renewed war.

cards.summary: North Korea fired multiple missiles, and Kim Yo Jong rejected dialogue with the US while denying responsibility for the theft of more than $6 billion in crypto. The FBI has said a North Korea-backed group was behind the Binance attack.
cards.why_it_matters: Stolen crypto is a funding source for Pyongyang's weapons programs, and talks with Washington look stalled.

sources.title: N Korea fires multiple missiles, denies US claims on Binance hack

cards.summary: The Financial Times reports Oracle cancelled a $7 billion AI deal with Tencent after pressure from the Trump administration. It comes amid growing tension for US AI infrastructure companies doing business with Chinese tech groups.
cards.why_it_matters: It shows the White House using informal pressure to limit US-China AI ties, adding uncertainty for US cloud and chip firms.

sources.title: Oracle cancels $7bn Tencent AI deal under Trump pressure

cards.summary: The Financial Times reports Qatar, once the top LNG producer, will control the largest share of US output by 2033. The shift follows Gulf investment in US export projects.
cards.why_it_matters: Gulf control of US gas exports could affect domestic gas prices and US leverage in energy markets.

sources.title: Qatar set to become world’s biggest buyer of US LNG

cards.headline: Australian inquiry calls Aukus 'worst, riskiest' defence decision
cards.summary: A public inquiry led by Peter Garrett and former defence chief Adm Chris Barrie called the $368 billion Aukus submarine deal the worst, riskiest and most costly Australian defence decision. It urged suspending the deal and holding a royal commission.
cards.why_it_matters: Aukus is a core US-Australia-UK security pact for countering China, so doubts in Canberra matter to Washington.

sources.title: Aukus is ‘worst, riskiest and most costly’ Australian defence decision ever, public inquiry into submarine deal says

cards.headline: EU says supermarket cyberattacks in 11 countries not isolated
cards.summary: Germany, Romania and the UK reported supermarket cyberattacks, and the EU said hacks in at least 11 countries are not isolated and urged action. A Romanian official said he suspects no state actor.
cards.why_it_matters: Attacks on food retailers can disrupt supply chains and shelves, and attribution remains unsettled.

sources.title: EU urges action as Germany, Romania and UK report supermarket cyberattacks

cards.headline: South Africans vote in local elections as ANC faces anger
cards.summary: South Africans voted in local elections amid frustration over water outages and power cuts. The Guardian says the ANC is expected to win less than a third of the vote. Residents told the BBC they are tired of poor services.

sources.title: Delhi air quality worsens ahead of Diwali as firework restrictions enter force

cards.headline: China's services activity slows unexpectedly for first time since July
cards.summary: A private survey showed China's services activity grew more slowly, with business confidence easing and firms cutting selling prices even as input costs rose.
cards.why_it_matters: Weak demand in the world's second-largest economy affects US exporters, commodity prices and global growth.

sources.title: China Services Gauge Unexpectedly Dips for First Time Since July

cards.summary: With years-long waits for grid access and new turbines, data center builders are using once-discarded jet engines to generate power, a less efficient and less environmentally friendly option, TechCrunch reports.

sources.title: Why Are Indonesians Dying in Ukraine?

cards.why_it_matters: It shows how Chinese labs try to work around US export controls through overseas cloud access.

sources.title: Chinese AI lab Moonshot turned to Europe for Nvidia Blackwell access amid U.S. China curbs, sources tell CNBC

cards.headline: US agencies warn of ongoing freezer hacks tied to Iran
cards.summary: A joint US government statement says hacks of industrial, retail and military freezers affect food, transportation and healthcare. Defense One reports officials suspect Iran-linked hackers at military commissaries.
cards.why_it_matters: Spoiled food and medical supplies are a direct risk, and attribution to Iran raises the stakes during the war.

cards.headline: Novartis reports seven tumor cases in children given Zolgensma
cards.summary: Novartis acknowledged seven previously unknown instances of tumors in children treated with its spinal muscular atrophy gene therapy, STAT reports. A causal link is described as possible.
cards.why_it_matters: The finding bears on the long-term safety of gene therapies given to infants.

sources.title: STAT+: Novartis cites cases of previously unknown tumors possibly tied to its SMA gene therapy

cards.headline: Revolution Medicines' pancreatic cancer drug has strong launch
cards.summary: Rasonque brought in far higher sales than expected in its first weeks, STAT and MarketWatch report, with one analyst calling it on track for one of the best drug launches of all time.
cards.why_it_matters: Pancreatic cancer has few effective treatments, so a successful new drug matters for patients.

cards.headline: Cancer diagnoses in England hit record, over 1,000 a day
cards.summary: NHS figures show record cancer diagnoses, but experts say the service is missing timescale targets for diagnosis and treatment.
cards.why_it_matters: It highlights strain in a major public health system and the global trend of rising cancer detection.

sources.title: Cancer diagnoses in England hit record high of more than 1,000 people a day

cards.headline: Germany names Army chief Freuding as next defense chief
cards.summary: Army Chief Christian Freuding will succeed Carsten Breuer as Germany's chief of defense in February 2027.
cards.why_it_matters: Germany is the largest European NATO military spender in the Ukraine war era, so its top commander matters to US planning.

sources.title: Germany names Army Chief Freuding as next chief of defense

cards.headline: Mexican judge arrested over alleged $2 million bribe
cards.summary: US officials say Judge Luis Benítez Alcántara took $2 million to release a Canadian suspect linked to Ryan Wedding's cocaine enterprise during extradition proceedings. The judge's response was not reported.
cards.why_it_matters: It shows US efforts to pursue cartel-linked corruption in extradition cases that affect drug flows into the US.

cards.headline: Eight killed in series of shootings in western Turkey
cards.summary: Victims were found in several locations in three separate vehicles, according to local reports cited by the BBC. A motive and suspects were not given.
cards.why_it_matters: Details are unclear, but mass shootings in a NATO member and tourist destination draw international attention.

sources.title: Eight killed in series of shootings in western Turkey

cards.headline: IRS 2027 tax brackets rise at steeper pace on inflation
cards.summary: The 2027 federal tax brackets, standard deduction and SALT limits were published, adjusting by more than this year as inflation persists, MarketWatch reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Bracket changes set how much of your income is taxed and show how inflation affects take-home pay.

sources.title: The 2027 tax brackets are out. See what the standard deduction and SALT tax breaks will be.

cards.headline: Florida chapter of CAIR suspends operations after designation
cards.summary: The Council on American-Islamic Relations suspended Florida operations as the state's terrorist designation took effect after a federal court declined to block it. CAIR's position on the designation was not detailed in the summary.
cards.why_it_matters: The case tests how far states can go in designating advocacy groups, with free speech and security arguments on both sides.

sources.title: CAIR shuts down in Florida after court upholds foreign terrorist designation

cards.headline: LIV Golf to wind down operations in bankruptcy court
cards.summary: A lawyer told a bankruptcy court that LIV Golf will shut down rather than launch a new version because it lacked enough support, ending a five-year run.
cards.why_it_matters: It ends a league that split professional golf and reshaped the sport's finances.

sources.title: LIV golf to shutter league, lawyer says in bankruptcy hearing

cards.headline: Cristiano Ronaldo retires from international football
cards.summary: Ronaldo, 41, ended a 23-year Portugal career spanning six World Cups after a falling-out with coach Jorge Jesus, according to Al Jazeera and the BBC.
cards.why_it_matters: It closes the international career of one of the world's most recognized athletes, with a large US fan base.

sources.title: Why has Cristiano Ronaldo retired from international football?

cards.headline: New evidence suggests Mars may be volcanically active
cards.summary: Recent surface fractures and gases detected by an orbiter provide some of the strongest evidence yet that Mars is volcanically active, New Scientist reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Active volcanism could mean heat and chemistry that improve the odds of finding life on Mars.

sources.title: Evidence of active volcanoes on Mars may boost chances of finding life

cards.headline: Siberian tomb hair shows cannabis use 2,800 years ago
cards.summary: Psychoactive compounds found in a hair from a Scythian tomb give the earliest direct evidence of cannabis being used as a drug.
cards.why_it_matters: It adds to the long human history of psychoactive plants as debates over cannabis policy continue.

sources.title: Tomb in Siberia reveals humans were using cannabis 2800 years ago

cards.headline: Wall Street donors spent over $300 million on GOP with little effect
cards.summary: Top hedge fund and private equity executives spent more than $300 million on Republican campaigns to little or no effect, the Financial Times reports.
cards.why_it_matters: It shows the limits of big-money influence in an election driven by cost-of-living concerns.

sources.title: Wall Street mega-donors clobbered by Democratic sweep

cards.headline: Asian markets brace for losses as Korean chip stocks sink 10%
cards.summary: Futures point to steep declines in Japan and elsewhere in Asia on Friday. South Korean chip stocks fell about 10% in pre-market trading on fears a Democratic Congress will slow AI infrastructure expansion.
cards.why_it_matters: The selloff is spreading globally, and Asian chipmakers supply much of the hardware in US devices.

cards.summary: IREN said some revenue is being pushed from 2026 into early next year at a customer's request, after a sharp stock drop. MarketWatch reported the shares later rose on a new cloud deal and investment-grade backlog.

cards.headline: Meta warns data center backlash could make AI expansion harder
cards.summary: Meta said growing political opposition to data centers, shown in the election, could threaten future AI investment as communities push back against large infrastructure projects.
cards.why_it_matters: Local fights over power and water now shape where AI gets built and what it costs.

sources.title: Meta warns that election backlash against data centers could make AI expansion harder

cards.headline: House Republicans ask Nvidia's Huang to brief Congress on China ties
cards.summary: Three House Republican committee chairs asked Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang for a closed-door briefing about reported ties to a woman accused of spying for China. Nvidia's response was not in the reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Nvidia chips are central to US-China technology rivalry and to the AI boom.

cards.headline: Trump says Iran war decision is coming soon
cards.summary: After meeting his national security team, Trump said he will soon decide whether to resume all-out war with Iran. Bloomberg reports oil is heading for its biggest weekly loss since April as investors weigh prospects of an end to the war.
cards.why_it_matters: The choice affects US troops, gasoline prices and the wider Gulf region.

cards.headline: Saudi-led coalition intercepts missile fired toward Medina
cards.summary: A Saudi-led coalition intercepted a missile fired toward Medina. Al Jazeera says it followed a Saudi civil defence warning of potential danger near the port of Yanbu. The origin of the launch was not stated in the summary.
cards.why_it_matters: An attack near Islam's second-holiest city and a key oil port could widen regional tensions and unsettle energy markets.

sources.title: Saudi coalition intercepts missile fired towards Medina

cards.headline: Iran war is draining US naval forces from the western Pacific
cards.summary: Defense One reports the war on Iran is pulling US naval forces out of the western Pacific. One expert called it a problem for credibility and for allies in the Far East.
cards.why_it_matters: Thinner US presence in Asia affects deterrence against China and the confidence of allies like Japan and South Korea.

sources.title: The war on Iran is stripping the western Pacific of US naval forces

cards.headline: RAF Fairford air show moved permanently after suspected terror threat
cards.summary: Organizers of the world's largest military air show said it is leaving RAF Fairford for MOD Boscombe Down, over a month after a suspected Iranian plot against the base.
cards.why_it_matters: Fairford hosts US forces, and the plot shows how the Iran conflict reaches allied bases in Europe.

sources.title: Popular military air show permanently pulled from RAF Fairford after suspected terror threat

cards.headline: Nithya Raman declared winner of Los Angeles mayoral race
cards.summary: Democratic socialist Nithya Raman defeated incumbent Mayor Karen Bass and will be the city's first South Asian mayor. She campaigned on homelessness and affordable housing, and Axios noted New York's Zohran Mamdani is also a democratic socialist.
cards.why_it_matters: The nation's two largest cities will now have democratic socialist mayors, a shift in big-city Democratic politics.

cards.summary: Democrats flipped five Republican-held North Carolina seats, drawn in 2023 to favor Republicans, plus Arizona's 6th, where JoAnna Mendoza beat Rep. Juan Ciscomani. Cait Conley is projected to beat Rep. Mike Lawler. Republican Paul LePage flipped Maine's 2nd.

cards.summary: Fox News reports the FBI interviewed former Alaska Republican lawmaker David Eastman, who described a mystery recruiter. Fox says a Democratic operative allegedly posed as a conservative recruiter in the Senate race; the claim is unproven.
cards.why_it_matters: The inquiry bears on a Senate race still too close to call and on rules for candidate recruitment.

cards.headline: Transgender and noncitizen-voting measures pass in several states
cards.summary: Voters in Nebraska and Arizona approved restrictive transgender ballot measures, the Washington Examiner reports. Fox News says five states approved noncitizen voting bans. STAT reports voters also decided abortion, marijuana and transgender youth care measures.
cards.why_it_matters: The results show where state-level policy on contested social issues moved even as Democrats won nationally.

cards.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth authorized the National Guard in Washington to use boats, up to 60 marked police cars and military tactical vehicles, a Pentagon official confirmed. Fox reports a D.C. council hearing demanded the military presence be removed.
cards.why_it_matters: It expands a military role in the capital's policing, a live dispute over federal power and local control.

cards.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth urged Congress to approve $350 billion in military funding and said he will fight Democratic impeachment efforts. Breaking Defense says reconciliation, appropriations and the NDAA will compete for attention.

cards.headline: Trump signs proclamation making Oval Office a national monument
cards.summary: Trump signed a proclamation designating the Oval Office and Cabinet Room a national monument. He noted Congress would have to ratify it, and that no major modifications could be made without congressional approval.
cards.why_it_matters: It is an unusual use of monument powers on the seat of the presidency; its legal effect depends on Congress.

sources.title: Trump signs proclamation making Oval Office, Cabinet Room national monument

cards.headline: Trump adviser urges Senate Republicans to look beyond Thune
cards.summary: Trump adviser Alex Bruesewitz publicly called on Senate Republicans to consider an alternative to Majority Leader John Thune, saying the party was rewarding failure after its midterm losses. Thune has not responded in the reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Leadership fights inside the GOP affect how the party opposes a Democratic Congress.

sources.title: Trump adviser calls for alternative to Thune for Senate GOP leader

cards.headline: Rep. Casten challenges Maxine Waters for top Financial Services post
cards.summary: Rep. Sean Casten (D-Ill.) formally launched a bid to chair the House Financial Services Committee, challenging longtime Democratic leader Rep. Maxine Waters. He asked colleagues for support in a letter.
cards.why_it_matters: The chair would steer oversight of banks, crypto and housing finance in a Democratic House.

sources.title: Sean Casten launches bid for House Financial Services chair

cards.headline: Epstein files return to the spotlight as Congress reconvenes
cards.summary: Axios reports Congress returns next week facing a renewed push for transparency on the Jeffrey Epstein files, as a top House Democrat promises new investigations after the party's midterm victories.
cards.why_it_matters: Democratic control gives the party subpoena power over an issue that has divided both parties.

sources.title: Epstein files back in spotlight after midterms

cards.headline: Rubio denies resignation rumors, will speak to Federalist Society
cards.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio will headline the Federalist Society's National Lawyers Convention next week, his first speech since the midterms. The Washington Examiner says the news came as rumors of his resignation circulated; he has denied them.
cards.why_it_matters: The top US diplomat's status matters for the Iran war, Ukraine talks and relations with allies.

sources.title: Rubio to deliver first post-midterm speech as he denies resignation rumors

cards.headline: Wisconsin reports infant measles death, first since 1990
cards.summary: Wisconsin health officials said an infant died in connection with the state's ongoing measles outbreak, the first measles death there in more than 30 years. The coroner listed the immediate cause of death.
cards.why_it_matters: Measles is preventable by vaccine, and the death shows the stakes of the continuing outbreak.

cards.headline: October jobs report due Friday after tech-stock rout
cards.summary: The Bureau of Labor Statistics releases October nonfarm payrolls Friday at 8:30 a.m. ET. MarketWatch says it could bring investors relief or add to losses after the tech selloff.

cards.headline: Canada's budget funds sovereignty and homelessness using oil windfall
cards.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney plans to use an oil revenue windfall to bolster Canada's economic and cultural sovereignty and address cost-of-living concerns, with billions for sovereignty and tackling homelessness.
cards.why_it_matters: Canada is the largest US trading partner, and its push for sovereignty affects cross-border trade and defense ties.

sources.title: Canada's federal budget includes billions for sovereignty and tackling homelessness

cards.headline: Brazil lists rare earths and copper as top critical minerals
cards.summary: Brazil approved its first list of critical and strategic minerals under a new national policy meant to attract investment and expand domestic processing, with rare earths and copper at the top.
cards.why_it_matters: Western countries are seeking minerals outside China, and Brazil could become a larger supplier for US industry.

sources.title: Brazil Puts Rare Earths, Copper Atop Critical Minerals List

cards.headline: ANC on track for record low in South African local elections
cards.summary: With more than 60% of votes counted in municipal elections, the African National Congress had about 32% of the vote, according to Al Jazeera.
cards.why_it_matters: A weaker ANC could reshape coalition politics in Africa's most industrialized economy.

sources.title: South Africa’s ANC on track for new lows in local polls

cards.summary: Hoax bomb threats caused emergency landings and evacuations across Europe, targeting at least 27 flights. The BBC says there is no hard evidence linking them to Russia, Iran or proxies, though hybrid-warfare concerns persist.
cards.why_it_matters: Disruption affects travelers, including Americans in Europe, and raises questions about hybrid attacks on the continent.

cards.summary: The lead detective urged other potential victims to come forward after it emerged Russell Brand is under investigation for two further rape allegations and faces a civil case. Brand was convicted of rape earlier this week.

cards.headline: Former Turkish minister Kaya arrested in investment fund probe
cards.summary: Fatma Betul Sayan Kaya, former deputy chair of President Erdogan's AK Party, was arrested in an investigation into alleged manipulation involving investment funds and stocks, state-run Anadolu Agency reported.
cards.why_it_matters: The case touches Turkey's ruling party and its financial markets, a major NATO member's economy.

cards.summary: Deutsche Telekom CEO Tim Höttges said he takes SpaceX seriously but that making Starlink Mobile a major US carrier would cost at least $200 billion. His company owns T-Mobile.
cards.why_it_matters: Competition from Starlink could change what Americans pay for mobile service, if it succeeds.

cards.headline: CesiumAstro raises $730 million at valuation above $4.5 billion
cards.summary: Space communications maker CesiumAstro closed a $730 million Series D led by Janus Henderson, valuing it at more than $4.5 billion, and unveiled a satellite constellation called Synchronicity.

cards.summary: The New York Times reports its parent company is in exclusive negotiations to acquire the film-lovers' social network Letterboxd for around $330 million. Sony Pictures and A24 were also rumored suitors.

cards.summary: Salon, one of the first online-only news magazines, announced it is ceasing publication, saying the business realities of independent digital journalism have changed profoundly.

cards.summary: Perplexity introduced Teammates, work-focused AI agents that can take on multiple roles in a workspace and draw on existing projects, skills and memory, competing with OpenAI and Anthropic offerings.

cards.summary: Meta said US users can now have real-time voice and video conversations with its Muse AI agent as a customizable animated avatar, ahead of a wearable designed to bring Muse to life.

cards.summary: Ars Technica reports judges are refusing to block state gambling laws from applying to Kalshi. One state attorney general argued Kalshi cannot avoid gambling law by claiming it does not offer gambling.
